steps.js: (function(){ var wu=window.__labWuMesh; if(!wu) return null; var e=window.__experience; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var V3=wu.position.constructor; var posAttr=wu.geometry.attributes.position; var minX=1e9,maxX=-1e9,minY=1e9,maxY=-1e9; var v=new V3(); for(var i=0;i<posAttr.count;i++){ v.set(posAttr.getX(i),posAttr.getY(i),posAttr.getZ(i)); v.applyMatrix4(wu.matrixWorld); v.project(cam); var sx=(v.x*0.5+0.5)*window.innerWidth, sy=(-v.y*0.5+0.5)*window.innerHeight; if(sx<minX)minX=sx; if(sx>maxX)maxX=sx; if(sy<minY)minY=sy; if(sy>maxY)maxY=sy; } var pad=40; return {x:Math.max(0,minX-pad), y:Math.max(0,minY-pad), w:Math.min(window.innerWidth, maxX-minX+pad*2), h:Math.min(window.innerHeight, maxY-minY+pad*2)}; })()
